faq.q: What can I make from one product photo?
faq.a: You can make short video ads, product and unboxing videos, white-background photos, lifestyle photos, model photos, and social ad images.
Upload a clear photo of the product you sell, with the whole item in frame. A phone photo on a plain background works well. Only upload photos you own or have permission to use.

faq.q: Can I use a product page link to start a video?
faq.a: Yes. URL to Video accepts a product page link. Choose the size and length, then check the credit price before the job starts.

faq.q: How much does a video or photo cost?
faq.a: Each job shows its credit price before you start. A photo or a 6-second clip is 24 credits, a 10-second clip is 40, 15 seconds is 60 and 30 seconds is 120. Credits for a failed job go back to your balance.

faq.q: Is the person in the video a real creator?
faq.a: No. The people in these clips are generated by AI. Use them as part of your product marketing, not as customer testimonials, and follow any platform rules for AI-generated content.

faq.q: Can I make more than one version of an ad?
faq.a: Yes. Run the same photo with another scene, presenter, voice, or language. Each run shows its credit cost first.

faq.q: Can I run these videos as paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and can be used commercially on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and marketplaces. Adjust captions and any price in the editor, then follow each platform's rules for ads and for AI labels.

faq.q: Do I need to hire a model or creator?
faq.a: No. The results start from one product photo, so there is no casting, sample shipping or filming date. Present people in the clips as part of your ad, not as customer reviews.
Yes. Auto captions come with the clip. Change the wording, color, and font in the built-in editor, and proofread every price before you post.

faq.q: Can I edit the clip after it is made?
faq.a: Yes. Change text, captions, colors, and music in the built-in editor. A new scene, presenter, frame, or length is a new job, and you see the credit cost before it starts.
Yes. Type your own line, or ask for a draft from the product name and the photo. Edit that draft before the presenter reads it.

faq.q: Can the presenter speak another language?
faq.a: Yes. Write the script in the language you sell in and pick a voice for that line. Run the same photo again when you need another language.

faq.q: Can I publish to TikTok or Meta from here?
faq.a: Yes. When the file looks right, publish it to TikTok or Meta from your account. You still follow each platform's rules for ads and for labeling AI.
Yes. Pick a track from the music library, then proofread captions and any price on screen.

faq.q: Can I generate videos from my own app?
faq.a: Yes. Send a product photo or a page link through the AIVideosUGC API and get a video back. The same credit price applies, and a failed call returns its credits.
